m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Quelle chance! The Hero of Walruskberg arrives in our time of need. The crooked Inspectors are harassing my husband in the Stockroom! Help him!
Silence! We've given you multiple warnings, Coleridge, yet we continue to receive reports of rats in this establishment. Clean up, or pay up!
Ye featherbrained fishflingers wouldn't know a rat if it were standing right in front of ye! We ain't bribin' ye without a fight! Yar!
Was that a threat? According to law 41-861B, threatening a city official is a capital offense. Prepare to be punish- who are you?
W-Wizard? H-How ye been? What brings ye... actually, whataya say ye help me swab this scum out of me Stockroom, then we catches up?
Hehe, Coleridge, I did not know you were friends with the Hero of Walruskberg. Perhaps I was a bit overzealous.
Upon further inspection, I officially declare this establishment: Health Code Compliant. Au Revoir!
Thank the seventy seas ye wandered in when ye did, old friend. Come! Let me pour ye a tasty tiki drink. On the house!
Mon amour, what happened? The vile Inspectors... they ran away so fast! Was Escoffier crying? Hehehehe
Yar! Sounds as though we've both led exciting lives since we parted last! Come, let us swap stories over tropical-themed novelty beverages!
And all who heard should see them there, and all should cry, beware! Beware! The crooked Inspectors won't be bothering us anymore, me love.
C'est magnifique! The Hero of Walruskberg strikes again! I will pour for you our most popular drink - a Poissoncolada!
The mission requires a Sky Captain with experience in Empyrea. I'm sure we don't need to explain how limited that selection is. Ha-ha.
There is only one such person known to us Scholars - A Wharf Rat of dubious reputation by the name of Captain Taylor Coleridge.
You remember him, right? As we understand it, you and old Coldbridge... er... Coleridge met in Khrysalis a while back.
And we're hoping that relationship will help recruit Coleridge to this mission. He's not my first choice, but he'll have to do.
Our intelligence has tracked him to Polaris. I'll mark the location on your Map.
Captain Coolranch is essential to the mission. Whatever it takes to convince him to help, you do it. Whatever it takes!
Hurry off to Walruskberg! That Captain Coolfridge... uh... Coleridge isn't going to recruit himself to sail the Ark to Empyrea.
